what: Inputs of the search-only smoke test of the whole-question lookup, 2026-11-21: the scoped lookup question each of three X12 draws sent in its run (which read only US federal rules), and the same question with the whole request put first as lookup_questions builds it. Kept because the run databases they came from are not.

question.request: Under the current edition of the international safety requirements for transporting radioactive material, a freight container used as packaging (not under exclusive use) has a maximum dose rate of 0.08 mSv/h measured at 1 m from its external surfaces, and the largest cross-sectional area of the load is 3 m2. What transport index (TI) is assigned, and is it within the TI limit for such a container?

gaps: The TI limit for a freight container NOT under exclusive use under the applicable edition (this decides compliance, not just detail)
Whether the container qualifies as a single package 'freight container used as packaging' versus a consignment of packages, since different TI limits and aggregation rules apply
